gold_insights.insight: Shows the natural mineral form of perovskite.
Certified 17.2% total-area efficiency achieved on 7200 square centimeter modules.

Ideal perovskite crystal structure comprises Sr, Ti, and O atoms.
The legend identifies Strontium, Titanium, and Oxygen as key components.
